chapter: Opening and the New York trip
title: Name and the nickname Montudie
summary: Garland gives his full name, Edward Bertrand Garland, and explains his nickname 'Montudie', meaning the Duke.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: What's that? Waiters don't get nothing? No.
Can we get your name? Can we get your name? What's your right name? My name is Edward B. Garland.
What's the B for? Bertrand. Oh, you kind of a lot of Bertrands?
Buddy Bertrand? And what's your name, the man with the camera over there?

My name is Floyd Levin, but I'm going to tell you something, Tutti, all these years I never knew. My middle name is Bertrand. Would you believe that? I don't know about that. Bertrand, yes, I've kept that a secret. Well, it's, uh...
Uh, well, you got another name too that everybody calls you that you love so... You must love that, huh?
What does that mean in English, or should I ask?
Where'd you get that name? Well, I got that name...
This old guy around New York they used to call... Montutti. Oh, yeah. And, uh...
